stock-starter-holy-water.scope: Both Holy Water variants were gated at rest and used against an active NPC opponent. Neutral and matching weakness hits, IS and reuse were observed. The player cure and RSI callbacks still need coverage.

targeting.source: GOB 547 uses enemy selector 3 and CastWhenUsed 3. general.py resolves Holy Water on the direct object.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler uses the same Exile-weapon admission path for both variants. It resolves the current live interlock opponent before charging, then queues the move against that opponent.
targeting.test: PR750 verifies the stock client blocks the shortcut at rest and sends 547 through the ordinary live-opponent path. It costs 20 IS with no own timer and lands for 11 neutral and 111 with Holy Water weakness. Wooden Stake is a nonmatching control. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/750#issuecomment-7080402499
